name: 51041 · Orange City, IA
findings: ZIP 51041 (Orange City) has 49 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (22%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 51041 (Orange City) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 9 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 20% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 51041 (Orange City) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
